image_pattern_summary: Verified good images consistently show a complete MS portable cabin unit photographed from a slight angle or straight-on, with corrugated steel panel walls, barred windows, and a door clearly visible. Units are typically shown in outdoor settings (bare ground, grass, or white background) with the full structure in frame including roof, walls, and base/leg supports. Color schemes are predominantly white-and-blue or grey, with some units featuring verandas, railings, or multi-room configurations.

reason: Verified good images show the physical structure of the portable cabin — corrugated steel panels, windows, doors, and roof — as the primary information carrier; no meaningful text is printed on the product exterior.
OCR would extract no useful product specification data from these images as the product identity is conveyed entirely through its visual form, dimensions, and construction details.
